data.case_title: MusterFit Studios – dunning for returned November 2025 membership fee
data.explanation: MusterFit Studios (the gym) tried to collect your November 2025 membership fee by direct debit, but your bank returned it. The gym is now charging you a dunning fee (Mahngebühr) on top of the fee and asks you to settle the total open amount by the date given in the letter. Transfer the amount to the IBAN shown, using your membership number as reference if possible. If you already paid or the debit has meanwhile gone through, you can treat this letter as settled, as it says. If you do nothing, MusterFit may pursue further collection steps, although this letter does not spell out what those would be.
